fusions.name: Silk Snare
fusions.desc: Sends a strand that deals 9 damage with a 30% chance of [Pinned] for 2 seconds. It costs 4% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Gossamer Spray
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of silk 5 tiles long, dealing 9 damage to everything in it, with a 50% chance of [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Web Snare
fusions.desc: Conjures a snare onto the nearest enemy. It waits 20 seconds, and the first 2 enemies to come within 3 tiles take 14 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Plucked Strand
fusions.desc: When a condition you inflicted expires, a strand lashes the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 10 seconds.
